f4.quote: Periodic boundary conditions in X and Y; contractive boundary in Z

f5.quote: NVE ensemble for bulk; Langevin thermostat for constant temperature layer

f6.quote: ordered lattice with stable dislocation density at 300-600 K

f7.quote: rapid lattice disorder and significant dislocation density reduction at 900-1200 K

f8.quote: At >900 K, rapid lattice softening and disorder cause a sharp decrease in hardness and elastic modulus, shifting the deformation mechanism from stacking faults to lattice disorder

f9.quote: increased HCP atom fraction with temperature

f10.quote: Wear resistance and hardness remain relatively stable up to 600 K, then decrease sharply above 900 K

f12.quote: friction coefficient and tangential force increase with temperature, with significant fluctuations above 900 K
